name: Rocket Boosting
description:
Sneaking or jumping while airborne performs an upward [orange]rocket boost[/orange] and resets accumulated fall distance. You can perform [effect:boosts][dark-gray]2-3 rocket boosts[/dark-gray][/effect] before landing.

You fall +4 blocks before taking fall damage.

effects.explanation:
Level I: 2 rocket boosts
Level II: 3 rocket boosts
